jobs.title: Data Center Technician
jobs.description:
National Technologies (NTI), a Network Connex Company, is a premier turnkey installer of fiber optic and data center infrastructure. Working on our team puts you on the leading edge of innovation in the digital communications space.  

If being a part of a tight-knit organization that operates in some of the most advanced technology environments around the world sounds like a dream job, NTI might be the right fit for you! With the perks of a large organization, NTI remains true to its roots as a home-grown company with an open door culture that welcomes new ideas and encourages professional growth. We set you on the right path with careful onboarding and thorough training programs that prepare you for success in your role and beyond.

POSITION SUMMARY 

 The Technician - Data Center Construction supports the installation of data center infrastructure, including racks, cabinets, grounding systems, fiber guide, Unistrut, ladder rack, and structured cabling. The position maintains control of inside plant (ISP) activities at assigned work sites, reads and interprets ISP diagrams and drawings, and prepares and maintains accurate field notes.
This is a field-based position that may require overtime, weekends, holidays, and off-hours work. Travel may be required based on business needs.

 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

 • Install data center cages and overhead ladder rack in accordance with applicable industry standards.
• Read and follow design engineers' instructions and specifications, maintain the approved project scope of work, and adhere to required safety procedures.
• Prepare accurate engineering field notes; interpret engineering drawings and maps in the office and field; and recommend changes when required.
• Understand customer requirements and adhere to established project timelines.
• Demonstrate budget-conscious behavior by supporting profitability on new, ongoing, and completed projects.
• Use professional networks, as requested, to help identify qualified project managers and technicians.
• Support company initiatives and a positive work environment that strengthens organizational morale and operational efficiency.
• Coordinate and communicate work activities effectively with employees, departments, management, customers, and project stakeholders.
• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned based on business needs.

 QUALIFICATIONS 

 • High school diploma or GED required.
• Five or more years of relevant experience in telecommunications, data center construction, structured cabling, electronics, or a related field.
• Relevant education or training in electronics, telecommunications, construction, or project management preferred.
• Valid driver's license and satisfactory driving record required.

 
 KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES 

 • Knowledge of basic tools, construction practices, and communications networks.
• Knowledge of basket tray, overhead conveyance, ISP racks, cabinets, ladder rack, fiber guide, and termination panels from various manufacturers.
• Ability to read and understand blueprints, drawings, maps, specifications, and field instructions.
• Knowledge of cable installation practices, including cable dressing and lacing.
• Basic knowledge of AC and DC power plants.
• Knowledge of fiber optic cable types, cable construction, and manufacturer specifications necessary to prevent cable damage.
• Knowledge of cable testing procedures and test equipment.
• Knowledge of inside plant safety requirements and the ability to follow site-specific data center security processes.
• Proficiency with Microsoft applications and the ability to maintain accurate electronic and field documentation.
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
• Ability to work effectively as part of a team and communicate clearly with others.

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT 

 The physical demands described are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position. The role may require sitting, standing, walking, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, and working in active construction and data center environments. The employee must be able to lift and move up to 75 pounds and work in varying weather and environmental conditions. Appropriate personal protective equipment and compliance with customer and company safety requirements are required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 

 Pay rates and benefit levels are determined by applicable union classifications and are set by the union.

 DISCLAIMER 

 This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties and responsibilities may be changed or assigned based on business needs.

jobs.description:
If being a part of a world-class organization that operates in some of the most advanced technological environments around the world sounds like a dream job, Network Connex might be the right fit for you! You’ll be part of a team working together to solve customer problems every day, with compensation and benefits that are an investment in your career, financial future, and overall well-being. 
In addition to competitive base pay, Network Connex offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health you can begin participating in our programs on the first of the month following your start date. 
Join our Vanguard 401(k) plan, with immediate vesting and a generous company match to help you build long-term financial security. Our team also enjoys 10 paid company holidays, a generous PTO accrual schedule, and access to discounts on useful products and services.
 
Job Description
 A field lead focused on long-haul fiber optic cable testing nationwide is primarily responsible for installation, maintenance, and comprehensive testing of fiber networks that transmit data over long distances. This role demands precision, technical expertise, and a willingness to travel extensively.
 
40% Travel to nearby states
 
Key Responsibilities:
Installation and Splicing: Install, terminate, label, and route fiber optic and copper cabling systems in various environments (e.g., underground, aerial, data centers). This includes performing precise fusion and mechanical splicing to ensure low signal loss connections.
Testing and Troubleshooting: Conduct comprehensive end-to-end testing using specialized equipment like Optical Time-Domain Reflectometers (OTDRs), power meters, light sources, and visual fault locators to verify network performance, measure signal strength, and diagnose faults.
Maintenance and Repair: Possible to perform routine maintenance and respond to emergency calls to troubleshoot and restore service outages promptly. This involves identifying root causes of problems, repairing damaged cables or components, and replacing faulty equipment.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate and detailed records of all installations, test results, repairs, and material usage, often using digital mapping tools or software.
Safety and Compliance: Adhere to all safety protocols (e.g., OSHA guidelines) and industry standards (e.g., TIA/EIA) when working with lasers, electrical equipment, and in diverse field environments.
 Collaboration: Work effectively with engineers, project managers, and other team members to ensure seamless project deployment and completion.
Key Qualifications and Skills:
Experience: Require a minimum of 2-4 years of hands-on field experience in fiber optics or a related telecommunications field.
Experience in long-haul or large-scale backhaul projects is highly valued.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and site plans. 
Technical Proficiency:
Hands-on experience and troubleshooting ability to use test results to diagnose and solve complex problems in the field by utilizing fiber optic cable and testing specialized equipment to complete the following:
Fiber Inspection and Cleaning
OTDR (Optical Time Domain Reflectometer)
Power Meter
Fiber QuickMap
OLTS (Optical Loss Test Set)
ORL (Optical Return Loss)
Gig-E Testing
Visual Fault Locator (VFL)  
Physical and Environmental Demands:
Ability to perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting up to 50 lbs., climbing ladders, and working in confined or elevated spaces.
Willingness to work outdoors in various weather conditions and travel frequently (often up to 80-90%).
Soft Skills:
Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail
Meticulousness in tasks like cleaning connectors, which is crucial to avoid inaccurate readings caused by dirt or damage.
Excellent communication skills to coordinate with installation teams, engineers, and project managers,
Adaptability to work in various environments and under tight deadlines.
Capacity to work both independently and as part of a team are essential.
Certifications:While not always required, certifications like the Fiber Optic Association (FOA) Certified Fiber Optic Technician (CFOT) or other specialized certifications (e.g., in splicing or testing) are highly desirable and can enhance job prospects.
 
Licensing:
 A valid driver's license with a clean driving record is a standard requirement

Candidates must have a proven track record of splicing and testing for Zayo and other dark fiber providers, along with extensive experience using Fujikura fusion splicing machines, EXFO testing equipment, and FastReporter software.

 Job Duties and Responsibilities: 

 
 Fiber Splicing and Installation: 
 
 Perform fusion splicing on high-count fiber cables, including 864ct, 1728ct, and 3456ct, with precision and adherence to industry standards.

 Execute mid-sheath (ring-cut) splicing on high-count fiber cables to support network expansions and repairs.

 Conduct live fiber network splicing during designated maintenance windows to minimize service disruptions.

 Install fiber optic cables in various environments, including underground, aerial, and indoor settings.



 Testing and Troubleshooting: 
 
 Perform Optical Time-Domain Reflectometer (OTDR) testing to evaluate fiber optic cable integrity and performance.

 Conduct Optical Loss Test Set (OLTS) testing to measure signal loss and ensure network reliability.

 Troubleshoot live/active network fiber issues, identifying and resolving faults to maintain service continuity.

 Generate detailed FastReporter reports to document test results, splicing activities, and network performance for client submission.



 Equipment and Software Proficiency: 
 
 Operate Fujikura fusion splicing machines to achieve low-loss splices on high-count fiber cables.

 Utilize EXFO testing equipment for accurate OTDR and OLTS testing, ensuring compliance with client specifications.

 Leverage FastReporter software to produce comprehensive reports for network documentation and quality assurance.



 Additional Technical Tasks: 
 
 Pull fiber optic cables through conduits, ducts, or other pathways to support network installations.

 Assist in bolting telecommunications cabinets to secure infrastructure components (preferred skill).

 Install basket trays to organize and protect cabling systems (preferred skill).

 Operate scissor lifts safely for aerial or elevated work (preferred skill).



 Safety and Compliance: 
 
 Adhere to all safety protocols, including OSHA regulations and NTI’s safety standards, to ensure a safe working environment.

 Maintain a clean workspace and follow proper handling procedures for fiber optic materials and equipment.

 Complete required documentation for splicing, testing, and maintenance activities in accordance with company and client standards.



 Work Schedule and Environment: 
 
 Work indoors and outdoors in various weather conditions, adapting to project requirements.

 Perform tasks during daytime and occasional nighttime maintenance windows as required by client schedules.

 Stand for extended periods (8-10 hours per day) and perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds.




 Education and Experience: 

 
 Experience with Dark Fiber Providers: 
 
 Minimum of 2-3 years of verifiable experience splicing and testing fiber optic cables for Zayo and other dark fiber providers, with a demonstrated ability to meet stringent quality and performance standards.



 Equipment and Software Expertise: 
 
 At least 3 years of hands-on experience using Fujikura fusion splicing machines for high-count fiber splicing (864ct, 1728ct, 3456ct).

 Minimum of 3 years of experience performing OTDR and OLTS testing with EXFO testing equipment, ensuring accurate diagnostics and reporting.

 At least 2 years of experience producing FastReporter reports for network documentation, with proficiency in analyzing and presenting test data.



 Technical Skills and Knowledge: 
 
 Proven ability to perform mid-sheath (ring-cut) splicing on high-count fiber cables.

 Familiarity with live fiber network splicing during maintenance windows to ensure minimal service disruption.

 Strong troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving issues on live/active network fiber.

 Experience in cable pulling to support fiber optic network installations (required).

 Knowledge of cabinet bolting techniques (preferred).

 Familiarity with installing basket trays for cable management (preferred).

 Experience operating scissor lifts for elevated work (preferred).



 Physical and Environmental Requirements: 
 
 Ability to lift and carry a minimum of 50 pounds.

 Ability to travel nationally. The average rotation is 10 days out, 5 days home.

 Capability to work indoors and outdoors in various weather conditions.

 Ability to stand for 8-10 hours per day and perform physically demanding tasks.



 Background and Compliance:

 Fluency in English for effective communication with team members and clients.

 Prior experience working on projects for major telecommunications carriers or dark fiber providers beyond Zayo.

Communications Electronics Installation Technician

 Position Overview 
 Crown is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Communications Electronics Installation Technician to support our floating electronics installation crew. This position requires 100% travel across the United States, often aligned with FAA regional boundaries.
 This role extends beyond traditional electronics work. The selected candidate must be capable of installing and integrating a complete communications facility, including infrastructure, grounding, cabling, radios, and supporting systems. While not initially designated as a formal lead role, this position offers significant opportunity for growth and increasing leadership responsibility based on performance.
 The technician may serve as a key on-site resource, interfacing directly with FAA Air Traffic and Technical Operations personnel while supporting installation and construction crews in the field.
  
 Key Responsibilities 
 Communications System Installation & Integration 
 • Install, configure, align, test, and troubleshoot VHF and UHF radios and associated communication systems

• Setup and support Radio Control Equipment (RCE)

• Connect and integrate Telco requirements including Commercial Telco, RCL, Field Cable, and Fiber Optics

• Install new radio racks, radios, and other Government Furnished Equipment (GFE)

• Remove and properly dispose of legacy communications equipment

• Perform baseline electronic readings and generate required documentation including FRDF in accordance with FAA Technical Handbooks

• Perform electronics testing procedures and coordinate frequency outages
  
 Infrastructure & Physical Buildout 
 • Mount and install antennas

• Run and terminate coaxial cables and other communication cabling

• Install and test grounding systems and implement surge protection measures

• Perform basic electrical wiring and connections

• Install and assemble equipment racks, cable trays, and electrical conduit

• Ensure proper infrastructure to support the communication system
  
 Engineering, Compliance & FAA Interface 
 • Read, interpret, and implement engineering diagrams, blueprints, and electrical wiring diagrams

• Follow provided engineering packages and participate in required field modifications

• Participate in pre-installation meetings

• Interface with FAA Air Traffic and Technical Operations during installations

• Work confidently in geographically isolated environments and create solutions to unique on-site challenges

• Provide guidance and support to other installation and construction crew members

• Communicate effectively with team members, management, and stakeholders

• Understand the practical implications of electrical and electronic circuitry
  
 Required Technical Experience 
 • Demonstrated experience installing and maintaining VHF and UHF ground-to-air communication equipment

• Familiarity with FAA National Airspace (NAS) communications systems, cabling, and equipment

• Ability to read and interpret schematics, blueprints, and wiring diagrams

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)
  
 Preferred Technical Skills & System Exposure 
 Experience with the following is strongly preferred but not required:
 • Spectrum Analyzer

• Time-Domain Reflectometer

• Signal Generator

• Oscilloscope

• Microwave systems

• Voice Switch systems

• Air Traffic Control systems

• Commercial Driver’s License and trailer experience

• Experience operating heavy equipment
  
 Minimum Required Qualifications 
 • Must be a U.S. Citizen

• Must possess a valid driver’s license

• Must be able to independently cover travel-related expenses in advance, which are reimbursed within approximately two weeks through a voucher system

• Must be able to obtain a federal security clearance. Clearance eligibility includes no legal offenses within the past five years, no ongoing legal issues, and honorable discharge if previously having served in the military.
 • Associate’s Degree or completion of a two-year technical training or certification program in a relevant field, plus a minimum of two years of relevant experience

• Ability to generate required FAA documentation including FRDF

• Setup capability for Radio Control Equipment (RCE)

• Understanding of Telco requirements including Commercial Telco, RCL, Field Cable, and Fiber Optics
  
 Physical & Work Environment Requirements 
 • Ability to stand, sit, crouch, and work in one position for extended periods

• Ability to lift up to 75 lbs and move up to 350 lbs with hand truck or pallet jack

• Ability to climb and work at heights exceeding 60 feet

• Ability to occasionally perform work under severe time restraints

• Must be in good physical condition and able to pass a physical fitness assessment if required
  
 Schedule & Travel 
 Typical schedule is Monday through Thursday, 6:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

Must be able to work non-standard hours depending on site requirements.

This is a 100% travel position.
  
 Compensation 
 Hourly Rate Range: $20.00 to $49.00 per hour (W2) 
  
 Compensation is determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity considerations.
 Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, geographic considerations, and business needs.
  
 Benefits 
 • 401K with company match

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans

• Generous PTO
  
 About Us 
 Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, and engineering, with deep expertise in air traffic management, survey administration, lifecycle data management for informed decision-making, infrastructure sustainment and modernization, emerging technologies, and National Airspace System (NAS) integration.
 For over 30 years, we have supported a diverse portfolio of clients—including the FAA, NASA, the Energy Information Administration (EIA), state and local governments, and commercial organizations such as the Ohio and North Carolina Departments of Transportation.
 As a prime contractor on several high-impact federal programs, Crown offers comprehensive capabilities in engineering, strategic planning, data analytics, software development, modeling and simulation, and regulatory compliance.
 We are at the forefront of enabling the safe and efficient integration of uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS) and advanced air mobility (AAM) into the NAS, while also supporting infrastructure modernization efforts through robust lifecycle data management solutions. Whether advancing innovative air traffic concepts, enhancing operational performance, or enabling the future of urban air mobility, Crown is committed to shaping a safer, smarter, and more efficient infrastructure landscape.

jobs.description:
At Johnson Controls, we help customers bring HVAC equipment from project handoff to startup, warranty, and ongoing service support. This Houston-based role sits at the center of Equipment North America (EqNA) work, coordinating field service, customer communication, and service readiness across sales, operations, and the branch team.

 Role Overview
 As the HVAC Equipment Commissioning Manager, you will serve as the main coordination point for equipment startup and warranty activity. You will work closely with the customer, Customer Resource Coordinators (CRCs), Systems Application Engineers (SAEs), Branch Operations Managers (BOMs), Truck Based Service Managers (TBSMs), and technicians to keep service scopes aligned, documentation accurate, and work completed on time.

 Key Responsibilities
 Support EqNA startup, warranty, and other service needs from project turnover through completion.
 Act as the single point of contact for service-scope coordination within the equipment contract and the direct interface with the EqNA customer.
 Partner with EqNA sales during estimating to help determine whether work can be handled as S/R or requires a Service Mechanical project.
 Prepare custom quotes for service items outside of Program, Commission, Adjust, and Train (PCAT) policy.
 Confirm technician readiness and training needs when contract and warranty expectations are finalized.
 Attend RTO meetings on complex projects or Planned Service Agreement (PSA) projects and flag service or warranty scope concerns.

jobs.description:
Wachter's greatest asset is the people who work here. Join the Wachter family and chart your career path!  
 
Wachter is accepting applications for an Electrical and Low Voltage Combination Technician at various locations across the United States. 
 
We seek self-motivated and reliable technicians for service and special installation projects, who can work independently and find solutions to complete the job. Long-term employment with competitive pay and exceptional benefits for qualified candidates. We value relationships and invest in our employees.
Position Summary
The Electrical and Low Voltage Combination Technician will support infrastructure initiatives across multiple and continuous retail sites with a strong emphasis on travel-based field work. This role combines electrical expertise with low voltage/data experience to support critical network, power, and infrastructure upgrades. Because these upgrades occur during off-hours to avoid site disruption, this position requires nearly exclusive overnight work (typically 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM) and the ability to work irregular hours based on project needs. Extensive travel, including overnight stays for up to multiple weeks at a time, is required.
Key Responsibilities
Install, configure, and replace network switches and related hardware 

 Mount, hang, rework or relocate IDF cabinets and associated components 

 Perform disconnect/reconnect of electrical power in accordance with safety and compliance standards 

 Reconfigure or relocate electrical circuits when required for cabinet moves or equipment changes 

 Conduct MDF and IDF room cleanups, including cable management, labeling, re-termination and documentation 

 Execute re-cabling projects for departments or operational areas needing infrastructure refresh. 

 Read and interpret electrical diagrams, network maps and construction plans 

 Ensure all work complies with electrical codes, low voltage standards, safety procedures and company guidelines 

 Collaborate closely with project managers, internal stakeholders and site contacts to coordinate work and provide updates 

 Maintain accurate records of work performed, materials used and conditions found 

 Troubleshoot electrical or network related issues onsite and recommend corrective actions 

 Travel extensively to assigned sites, often with short notice, to support project schedules
Required Qualifications
Electrical Journeyman or Apprentice license 

 3+ years of experience in electrical, low voltage or data infrastructure work 

 Proven experience with network equipment installation, including switches and rack mounted components 

 Ability to safely disconnect/reconnect power and perform basic electrical modifications 

 Strong understanding of MDF/IDF best practices, cable management and structured cabling standards 

 Ability to lift, mount and secure heavy cabinets and equipment up to 75 pounds 

 Valid Driver's License and the ability to travel 75-100% of the time 

 Outstanding attention to detail and commitment to high-quality workmanship 

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of providing clear status updates and work documentation 

 Comfortable working on ladders, lifts, and in confined or elevated spaces
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in retail, warehouse or large enterprise environments 

 Familiarity with NEC, TIA/EIA cabling standards and OSHA safety guidelines 

 Experience with fiber optic termination, network testing tools and cable certification hardware 

 Ability to lead or guide contractors or small teams onsite
Benefits Package
Company Paid:


 Medical, Dental, Prescription & Vision Benefits 

 Life, AD&D, and LTD insurance 

 Paid Vacation and Holidays

 Company-Matched 401K and IRA Retirement Saving


 Travel and Vehicle Package:


 Per-Diem paid when overnight travel is required 

 Drive time and mileage paid for use of a personal vehicle when travel is required 

 Company vehicle provided after orientation

We are seeking an experienced Low-Voltage Cable Technician to join our growing team. In this role, you will handle hands-on installations and lead small teams on multi-week projects. This position requires extensive travel, technical expertise, and strong leadership skills to deliver projects safely, on time, and within budget.

Full-time work

 Competitive Compensation based on experience

 Paid weekly

 Per-Diem paid when overnight travel is required

 Life, AD&D and LTD insurance

 Company-Matched 401(k) and IRA Retirement Savings
Key Responsibilities:

 Device Setup: Install and configure CCTV and network devices. 

 Project Leadership: Lead small teams on multi-week projects to ensure timely, safe, and budget-conscious delivery. 

 Blueprints: Read and interpret blueprints and site maps. 

 Aerial Work: Operate BOOM and/or scissor lifts to work at heights up to 40+ feet.

 Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of fiber optic termination, network infrastructure, and Point-of-Sale (POS) deployment/troubleshooting. 

 Licensing: Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUI/DWI in the last 3 years). 

 Transportation: Reliable personal transportation. 

 Tools: Must possess basic telecom tools and standard Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). 

 Leadership: Comfortable working independently and leading small teams. 

 Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel extensively (4–6 weeks at a time) and work flexible shifts, including nights and weekends.

Industry certifications: BICSI, OSHA, MSHA, AVIXA CTS, Panduit, Belden, or Corning. 

 Hands-on experience with fusion splicing. 

 Experience running DSX cable certification testing.

jobs.title: Low Voltage/Access Control Lead Project Technician
jobs.description:
Wachter's greatest asset is the people who work here. Join the Wachter family and chart your career path! 
 
Wachter is accepting applications for Low Voltage Lead Project Technicians for service and large project work at various locations across the United States. This position requires technicians to travel up to 95% of the time. 
 
We seek self-motivated and reliable technicians for service and special installation projects, who can work independently and find solutions to complete the job. Long-term employment with competitive pay and exceptional benefits for qualified candidates. We value relationships and invest in our employees.
Benefits Package: Company Paid!
Medical, Dental, Prescription & Vision Benefits

 Life, AD&D, and LTD insurance

 Paid Vacation and Holidays

 Company-Matched 401(k) and IRA Retirement Savings.

 Per-Diem paid when overnight travel is required.

 Drive time and mileage paid for use of a personal vehicle when travel is required.

 Company vehicle could be provided after initial 2-4 weeks of employment.
Requirements:
Experience as a Data Cable Technician.

 Available for extensive travel nationwide. 

 Strong knowledge of industry standards (BICSI, NEC, TIA/EIA).

 Industry-specific certifications (BICSI, Systimax, Panduit, Beldon, Corning) are a huge plus.

 Capable of reading blueprints and site maps.

 Experience in CCTV, voice, and data cabling is a plus.

 Excellent customer relationship and communication skills; verbal and written.

 Must be comfortable working unsupervised and also effectively communicating and collaborating with teams of 4 to 20 other technicians. 

 Knowledgeable in identifying independent colors and learning color codes.

 Ability to work in cramped spaces.

 Ability to operate a BOOM or scissor lift; and ability to work at heights, of 40 plus feet.

 Has basic telecommunication tools, PPE, and reliable transportation.

 Must have knowledge of cabling infrastructure.

 Experience in conduit installation is a plus.

 Valid driver's license with a clean driving record; no DUI or DWI in the last three years.
Responsibilities:
Installation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of various cabling infrastructure.

 Run low voltage cabling in commercial buildings, including drilling concrete walls and limited conduit work.

 Ensuring all cables are neatly tied and bundled according to safety regulations.

 Installing of cable support structures such as j-hooks, cable racks, and innerduct.

 Repairing cable poles and towers.

 Conduct tests to ensure all newly installed cables systems and component devices are operational.

 Troubleshoot issues with the cable network.

 Perform any other duties not specifically stated herein, but which your supervisor may assign.

 Maintain the company’s high standard of quality and professionalism with regards to workmanship, customer relations, coworkers, behavior, and appearance.

 Adhere to all required project safety requirements as set forth by Wachter, our customers, or OSHA.

 Job Description: 
 The Opportunity 
 The P&C Commissioning Engineer is responsible for on-site testing and commissioning of Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) and associated protection and control systems for electrical substations. This role involves installation supervision, testing, and commissioning of advanced digital systems, ensuring compliance with standards, safety, and project timelines. The P&C Field Engineer collaborates with project managers, customers, and technical teams to deliver reliable and high-quality solutions.
 
 How you'll make an impact: 
 
 Commissioning & Testing 
 Perform functional and acceptance testing of IEDs (protection relays, bay controllers, merging units) according to IEC 61850 standards.
 Configure and validate relay settings, logic, and communication parameters.
 Conduct GOOSE messaging and MMS verification for interoperability.
 Execute end-to-end testing of protection schemes using OMICRON CMC or equivalent tools.
 Validate time synchronization (SNTP/PTP) and redundancy schemes for IED networks.
 Document all IED test results and maintain compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

 
 Integration & Configuration 
 I ntegrate IEDs with MicroSCADA systems : Perform signal mapping, database configuration, and HMI validation to ensure accurate visualization and control.
 IEC 61850 Engineering : Validate Substation Configuration Language (SCL) files, including ICD, CID, and SCD, and ensure proper GOOSE and MMS communication between devices.
 Communication Protocols : Verify and troubleshoot interoperability for Modbus, DNP3, and IEC 61850 protocols across multi-vendor environments.
 Network Configuration : Set up and test Ethernet switches, VLANs, and redundancy schemes (PRP/HSR) for substation automation networks.
 Cybersecurity Compliance : Implement and verify secure access, password policies, and firewall settings in accordance with Hitachi Energy standards.
 System Performance Validation : Conduct end-to-end testing of SCADA integration, including alarms, events, and control commands, ensuring seamless operation between IEDs and MicroSCADA.

 Documentation & Reporting 
 Prepare commissioning reports, detailed test records, and as-built documentation for customer approval and internal archives.
 Maintain accurate logs of system configurations, parameter changes, and firmware updates for all IEDs and associated equipment.
 Ensure documentation complies with Hitachi Energy standards, IEC 61850 engineering guidelines, and project-specific requirements.
 Provide clear and organized records to support operational learning and future maintenance activities.
 Identify and document any non-conformances during installation, testing, or commissioning activities.
 Prepare Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) detailing the issue, root cause, and corrective actions.
 Communicate NCRs promptly to project managers and quality teams for resolution.
 Track and verify implementation of corrective actions before project close-out.
 Ensure NCR documentation aligns with Hitachi Energy quality management processes and customer requirements.

 Customer & Team Collaboration 
 Work closely with project managers, engineers, and customers during commissioning phases.
 Provide technical support and training to customers and site personnel.
 Participate in meetings to discuss commissioning progress and resolve issues.

 Health, Safety & Compliance 
 Ensure all commissioning activities comply with company HSE policies and site safety requirements.
 Promote a culture of safety and integrity during on-site work.

 
 
 
 Your Background: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
 3+ years of experience in field testing and commissioning of protection and control systems.

 Expertise in IED testing and configuration from major manufacturers:
 Strong knowledge of Hitachi ABB: REC670, REL670, REF615, RET670, and MicroSCADA integration.
 Experience with Siemens: SIPROTEC series (e.g., 5 series relays), DIGSI configuration tools.
 SEL (Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories): SEL-351, SEL-421, SEL-751, and AcSELerator software.
 Hands-on experience with advanced test equipment (OMICRON CMC, DOBLE) for secondary injection and end-to-end testing.
 Familiarity with SCADA integration, communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850), and Ethernet network configuration (PRP/HSR).
 Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to travel extensively within the assigned zone.
 Professional Engineering license or PMP certification preferred.

About Carrier 
 Carrier, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure the safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.
 
 About this role 
 Carrier is the leading global provider of healthy, safe and sustainable building and cold chain solutions with a world-class, diverse workforce with business segments covering HVAC, refrigeration, and fire and security. We make modern life possible by delivering safer, smarter and more sustainable services that make a difference to people and our planet while revolutionizing industry trends. This is why we come to work every day. Join us, and we can make a difference together. 
 
 * We support data center locations both north and south of Waco, TX, and are targeting candidates based between Dallas and Austin. Waco is the ideal location due to its convenient access to both sites; however, we are open to candidates who are willing to commute daily from Dallas or Austin.**
 
 As a HVAC Foreman Data Center Chiller Technician with Carrier, you will uniquely impact our customers, becoming the face of the confidence, we stand by while ensuring their comfort. Your knowledge of Commercial HVAC will be critical in working on a variety of installations, repairs, and maintenance projects. Chances to work independently and as a team will highlight your ability to both collaborate and individually make on-the-job decisions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about their trade and wants to take their skills to the next level. 
 
 We're seeking reliable and skilled HVAC Data Center Foreman Chiller Technician to deliver efficient and dependable cooling solutions in this rapidly evolving sector. Whether you’re an experienced HVAC technician or a journeyman looking to expand your expertise, this position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an industry shift and a pathway for professional development.
 
 This is ideal for an experienced HVAC professional who is passionate about their trade, enjoys leading teams, and thrives in high‑performance, customer‑focused environments.
 
 What you’ll do 
 Participate in startup and commissioning of new units, applying expertise to support a state-of-the-art facility.
 Perform diagnostic tests, troubleshoot mechanical and electrical malfunctions, and execute regularly scheduled maintenance on heating and cooling units.
 Review and interpret regulatory requirements and technical documents, including blueprints and diagrams.
 Cultivate strong customer relationships and ensure timely escalation of issues for resolution when necessary.
 Prioritize safety by adhering to licensing requirements, operating equipment safely, recognizing HVAC-related hazards, completing safety training, and implementing effective safety measures.

 
 Required 
 High School Diploma or GED
 Maintain a valid Driver’s License

The allergy and autoimmunity product lines operate on a common automated instrument platform, Phadia Laboratory Systems, which supports both productivity and cost efficiencies in clinical laboratories around the world.

 IDD Field Service Engineers (FSEs) provide exceptional on-site service on highly complex and integrated systems within hospitals and commercial reference laboratories in their assigned service territories. This is accomplished through technical expertise, teamwork, and superior customer service.

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.
 You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.
 Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.
 

 How it works 
 Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
 Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
 Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
 Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
 Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
 Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
 Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
 

 Requirements 
 2+ years of professional software engineering
 Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
 Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
 Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
 Regular use of an AI coding tool
 Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
 You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
 At least 10 hours a week, starting now
 A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

 Nice to have 
 Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
 Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

 Terms 
 US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
 Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
 The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
 Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

 Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.
 Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.
 About the Role 
 We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.
 This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.
 What You'll Do 
 Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

 Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

 Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

 Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

 Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.


 Who You Are 
 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

 Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

 Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

 Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

 Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

 Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

 Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams


 Extra Credit If You Have 
 Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

 Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

 Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

 Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions


 
 Why Youâll Love Working Here 
 Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.
 If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you .
 Benefits Include: 
 Competitive compensation, including equity

 Full health, dental, and vision coverage

 Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

 Flexible time off

 Opportunities for company-wide connection and events


 Ready to Make an Impact?
 Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.
 Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together .
 
 Employment Information 
 Work Authorization 
 Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
 Reasonable Accommodations 
 Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.
 Background Checks 
 Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.
 At-Will Employment 
 Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 Job Category
Software Engineering Job Details
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce 's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce .
 The Experience
 Salesforce and Google Cloud have embarked on a groundbreaking partnership worth $2.5 billion to revolutionize customer relationship management (CRM) through advanced artificial intelligence (AI). By integrating Google's Gemini AI models into Salesforce 's Agentforce platform, we're enabling businesses to harness multi-modal AI capabilities—processing images, audio, and video—to deliver unparalleled customer experiences. Join our team of talented engineers and help us advance the integration of Salesforce applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Software Security Engineer to join our GCP team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing our security posture across various domains, focusing on development, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, and the security of distributed and scalable distributed systems. This role requires hands-on experience with security systems, a deep understanding of modern threats, and the ability to drive security improvements through engineering solutions.

As a Software Security Engineer, you won’t just find vulnerabilities, you’ll engineer the systems that prevent them. You will play a pivotal role in securing our distributed micro-services architecture on GCP, moving security by building automated, high-performance tools that empower our entire engineering organization.

 What You'll Actually Be Doing:
 
 Security Engineering & Automation: Build and integrate high-performance security tools and custom scripts into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST/DAST, SCA, SIEM) to automate manual toil.

 Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and secure Terraform/IaC templates to ensure our cloud infrastructure is hardened by design before it ever reaches production.

 Vulnerability Leadership: Lead the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle, using a risk-based approach to prioritize remediation across network, cloud, and application layers.

 Architecture & Threat Modeling: Partner with DevOps and Product teams to conduct threat modeling and architectural reviews, ensuring new features are resilient and scalable.

 Compliance & Governance: Act as the technical lead for audits (SOC2, ISO 27001), leveraging automation to provide evidence of consistent monitoring and timely closure of risks.

 Production Resilience: Troubleshooting and resolving complex security issues in production using distributed tracing and modern monitoring tools.


 You're Our Person If:
 
 Engineering Mindset: 5+ years for SMTS, 7+ years for LMTS; 9+ years for PMTS in Security Engineering with a focus on building tools, not just managing them.

 Coding Proficiency: Strong experience in Go, Java, or Python with a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and automation.

 Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise: Deep experience with GCP (similar) and Terraform for managing cloud security posture (CSPM) and infrastructure.

 Security Domain Knowledge: Practical experience with network protocols, OS hardening (Linux), and modern attack vectors.

 Collaborative Spirit: A desire to work cross-functionally with DevOps to embed security into the SDLC.


 Even Better If:
 
 You have experience with secure software development lifecycle practices.

 You know container security tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.

 You have built or contributed to open source tools.



 Unleash Your Potential
 When you join Salesforce , you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
 Accommodations
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
 Posting Statement
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce , we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - 11686
jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
 Why join Coupa?
 
 
 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.

 
 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.

 
 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. 


 Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. 
 
 The Impact of a Principal Software Engineer at Coupa: 

 We're looking for someone who's rebuilt a production system while it was running. CSP (Coupa Supplier Platform) serves millions of supplier companies—it's where they find work, receive orders, issue invoices, and get paid. The platform started as a Rails monolith. It works, but it needs to evolve. More traffic, more features, multi-cloud deployment, higher availability requirements.

 You'll report to the VP of Engineering. CSP operates as a nimble team outside the larger engineering org, moving fast and pioneering approaches that demonstrate what's possible. You'll work with Ruby on Rails, Golang, Java—and introduce whatever else the architecture needs.


 What You’ll Do 
 
 Lead the architectural evolution. Traffic is growing, functionality is expanding, robustness matters more than ever. You'll define what changes, in what order, and why.

 Set the patterns: API design, microservice boundaries, deployment pipelines, monitoring, reliability. Make them real, not theoretical.

 Mentor engineers. Guide decisions. Review architecture and code. Build the kind of team that ships ambitious work.

 Join the Architectural Steering Group. Share what you learn with Principal Engineers across Coupa. Import what works elsewhere.

 Partner with SRE on cloud-native infrastructure: CI/CD, containers, infrastructure-as-code, multi-cloud capabilities.

 Own security, multi-tenancy isolation, data governance, and compliance across all regions.

 Work with product, design, and business teams to turn supplier workflows into systems that scale.



 What You Will Bring to Coupa 
 
 15+ years building B2B SaaS at scale. You've held leadership and architectural roles where your decisions stuck around.

 Real experience evolving legacy systems into microservices—in production, with users depending on uptime.

 Deep knowledge of API-driven services, multi-tenant architectures, and B2B integration patterns that handle millions of users.

 Solid foundation in modern deployment: CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, working with cloud providers like AWS or GCP.

 Comfort across technology stacks (Rails, Golang, Java) and the judgment to pick tools that solve problems, not resume lines.

 Track record mentoring teams—providing direction without micromanaging, staying technical without bottlenecking.

 Problem-solving skills that balance scale, performance, technical debt, and shipping features. You know the trade-offs because you've lived them.

 Communication skills that work across engineering, product, and business. You build consensus without watering down hard truths.



 
 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

 At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:

 Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally) 

 
 
 Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .

 
 Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .

 
 Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .

 
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .

 
 Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .

 
 Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .



 Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.

Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. 
 Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Software Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview
 We are designing the grid of the future! 
 ENER-i is a cutting-edge software solution from Electric Power Engineers (EPE) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. Backed by the collective expertise of EPE, ENER-i brings decades of industry engineering experience to the world of cloud-based, enterprise computing software. ENER-i's goal is to create a shared, secure, curated data platform, providing engineers with the means for intelligent data aggregation, insightful engineering analytics engines, GIS, network connectivity models, machine learning & augmented intelligence. Our mission is to close the gap between planning and operations; transmission and distribution and merge the interests of the government, the public, and private industry. 
 Responsibilities
 Join us in leading the change! 

 The Software Power Systems Engineer will work as a core member of the ENER-i software development team, owning the power systems engineering behind the platform's analysis modules from algorithm design through production code. This involves designing, developing, testing, and validating scalable engines and workflows for distribution system analysis. Such analyses include but are not limited to: quasi-static time-series (QSTS) unbalanced power flow, hosting capacity and DER interconnection screening, automated thermal and voltage violation mitigation, value of DER and non-wires alternatives analysis, flexible interconnection, reliability analyses, resiliency analyses, and DERMS operational planning, and long-term capacity and investment planning. 
 The level of the role (Engineer III, Senior, Principal, or Senior Principal) will be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience. Principal-level engineers are expected to set technical direction for the platform's powerflow analysis architecture and lead cross-team initiatives. 
 The Software Power Systems Engineer will also engage with the ENER-i product, engineering, and client delivery teams for tasks such as: 
 
 Distribution model conversion, validation, and onboarding (e.g., CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS) 

 Translating utility planning practices and criteria into technical specifications 

 Technical design reviews and architecture decisions for analysis engines 

 Validation of platform results against commercial tools and field data 

 Performance benchmarking and scale testing on utility-sized models 

 Client technical workshops, demonstrations, and user training 

 Perform and deliver ENER-i based distribution planning studies when needed 


 How you can make an impact: 
 Design and implement production-grade Python libraries and services for distribution analysis, power flow orchestration, and optimization within the ENER-i platform. 

 Scale simulations across thousands of feeders and full-year time-series through parallelization, cloud batch processing, and performance tuning – including compiled languages (e.g., Rust, C++) where it matters. 

 Build and maintain distribution data models and model converters that bring utility network models (CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS, GIS) into a common, validated representation. 

 Develop algorithms for automated mitigation, hosting capacity, DER valuation, and grid planning using optimization (LP/MILP), heuristics, and data-driven methods. 

 Establish test automation, validation suites, and engineering benchmarks that keep platform results accurate and trustworthy. 

 Serve as a distribution subject matter expert to developers, product owners, and product managers; review requirements and user stories for engineering correctness. 

 Propose and prototype new ENER-i modules and help shape the technical roadmap with product management. 

 Mentor engineers and developers, contribute to code and design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team. 

 Represent EPE through publications, open-source contributions, and industry working groups where appropriate. 

 Perform other duties as assigned. 

 Qualifications 
 Bring your passion, here's what’s needed: 
 Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a power systems focus, or a Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience. 

 3+ years (Engineer III) or 7+ years (Principal) of combined experience in distribution system analysis and software development; national laboratory, research, utility, and vendor experience all count. 

 Expert understanding of three-phase, unbalanced distribution systems, power flow formulations, and distribution planning practices. 

 Hands-on experience with at least one distribution modeling tool (e.g., OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, WindMil, or GridLAB-D), including its APIs or automation interfaces. 

 Strong Python software engineering skills beyond scripting: packaging, typing, automated testing, Git, code review, and CI/CD. OpenDSS experience is a plus. 

 A track record of building tools that other people use: libraries, applications, or open-source projects with real users. 

 Experience applying numerical methods and optimization (e.g., Pyomo, JuMP, Gurobi, HiGHS) to power systems problems. 

 Experience working with large data sets (time-series, AMI, SCADA) using tools such as pandas/Polars, SQL, or Parquet. 

 Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, particularly with respect to explaining complex technical matters. 

 Proven team player skills with ability to build and maintain internal and external relationships. 

 Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies (e.g., Scrum). 

 Beneficial Experience: 
 Proficiency in a compiled or high-performance language such as Rust, C++, Julia, or Java. 

 Contributions to open-source power systems tools (e.g., OpenDSS/AltDSS, DiTTo, GridLAB-D, PowerModelsDistribution, pandapower). 

 Experience with cloud-native development, containers, and distributed or high-performance computing (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). 

 Experience with DER integration topics such as hosting capacity, IEEE 1547, DERMS, flexible interconnection, non-wires alternatives, and electrification load forecasting. 

 Breadth across transmission, controls, or T&D co-simulation. 

 Familiarity with GIS tools (preferably Esri) and utility network data models. 

 Experience leveraging machine learning and AI tools responsibly to improve engineering quality and productivity. 

 Publications or participation in IEEE PES or similar industry working groups. 

 Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy. 
 How we support you: 
 
 Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you 

 Generous PTO and paid holidays 

 MyShare Employee Ownership Program 

 Work with industry leaders 

 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

 Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.
 This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.
 This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE , strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.
 The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.
 Key Responsibilities
 Software Verification & Testing
 
 Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.

 Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.

 Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.

 Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.

 Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.

 Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.

 Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.

 Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.


 Avionics Hardware & Software Integration
 
 Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.

 DO-178C Certification & Compliance

 Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.

 Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.

 Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.

 Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.


 Requirements Analysis & Traceability
 
 Review system and software requirements for clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability.

 Develop test cases and procedures directly from approved requirements.

 Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.

 Support requirements management and analysis using IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management tools.

 SCADE & Software Development Support

 Apply Java development experience to support software development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, or verification activities.

 Review software behavior and implementation as necessary to support test development and anomaly investigation.

 Collaborate with development engineers throughout verification and certification activities.


 Safety Critical Aviation Systems
 
 Support verification and certification activities for navigation avionics and related aircraft systems.

 Apply understanding of aircraft safety, system safety, and certification considerations when developing verification approaches.

 Support analysis of system performance and navigation related functionality.

 Participate in technical reviews involving software, hardware, systems engineering, and certification stakeholders.

 Maintain rigorous quality standards consistent with safety critical aviation development.


 Documentation & Technical Collaboration
 
 Develop clear and complete test procedures, test reports, verification records, and technical documentation.

 Document defects, anomalies, corrective actions, and test results.

 Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering teams and program stakeholders.

 Participate in peer reviews of requirements, test cases, procedures, results, and verification artifacts.

 Support reporting program and technical status activities as required.


 Minimum Required Qualifications
 
 Minimum eight years of professional software development, software verification, software testing, or related engineering experience .

 Minimum five years of Java development experience .

 Direct professional experience using SCADE .

 Direct experience supporting DO-178C software development, verification, testing, or certification activities .

 Demonstrated experience developing and executing requirements-based software test cases and procedures.

 Experience performing functional, system, integration, or performance testing of avionics systems.

 Experience testing software in conjunction with avionics hardware.

 Experience supporting avionics certification and testing activities.

 Experience with navigation avionics, aircraft navigation systems, inertial navigation systems, or closely related aviation systems.

 Experience with FAA certification activities, aircraft safety analysis, or other safety critical aviation development processes.

 Ability to analyze software and system requirements and translate requirements into executable verification activities.

 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

 Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to software quality.

 Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.

 Ability to work independently within a remote engineering environment.

 Must be a U.S. Citizen .


 Preferred Qualifications
 
 Experience with IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management and traceability tools.

 Experience performing detailed requirements analysis.

 Experience with inertial navigation, GPS aided navigation, guidance, or control systems.

 Experience with test automation.

 Experience developing or maintaining automated test frameworks.

 Experience with hardware in the loop, simulation, or laboratory test environments.

 Experience with structural coverage analysis tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, or comparable tools.

 Familiarity with static analysis tools.

 Experience with Python, C, C++, or other languages commonly used in embedded avionics verification.

 Familiarity with DO-254, ARP4754A, ARP4761, or related aviation development and certification standards.

 Experience supporting FAA or military airworthiness certification activities.

 Voor deze functie zoeken we een senior full-stack ontwikkelaar met een sterke basis in .NET en Angular. Je bouwt zelfstandig productieklare software en werkt mee in een moderne cloud- en DevOps-omgeving.
 Het team ontwikkelt en ondersteunt microservices en werkt daarnaast in een bredere .NET-ontwikkelomgeving waar vooral webapplicaties worden gebouwd. De opdrachten situeren zich binnen projecten, onderhoud en incidentwerking. Je maakt deel uit van een Agile developmentteam.
 KERNVERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN
 Analyse en ontwerp
 
 Meewerken aan functionele analyses en businessvereisten vertalen naar technische oplossingen.

 Technische ontwerpen opstellen voor nieuwe functionaliteiten.

 De technische haalbaarheid van nieuwe aanvragen en wijzigingsverzoeken beoordelen.

 Bijdragen aan de verdere verbetering van applicatiearchitectuur en codekwaliteit.


 Ontwikkeling en ondersteuning
 
 Webapplicaties en microservices ontwikkelen, onderhouden en optimaliseren.

 Bestaande toepassingen ondersteunen binnen projectwerking, onderhoud en incidentbeheer.

 Functionele uitbreidingen realiseren volgens business- en technische vereisten.

 Incidenten en technische problemen oplossen binnen de afgesproken servicelevels.

 Technische analyses uitvoeren en duurzame oplossingen voorstellen.


 Kwaliteit en testing
 
 Kwalitatieve, performante en onderhoudbare software opleveren.

 Unit tests opstellen en uitvoeren.

 Ondersteunen bij integratie-, systeem- en acceptatietesten.

 Werken volgens ontwikkelingsrichtlijnen, best practices en interne IT-standaarden.

 Analyses, ontwikkelingen en technische oplossingen correct documenteren.


 Samenwerking en productwerking
 
 Samenwerken met product owner, analisten, ontwikkelaars, testers en andere stakeholders.

 Actief deelnemen aan Agile ceremonies zoals sprintplanning, refinements, reviews en retrospectives.

 Releaseactiviteiten ondersteunen en bijdragen aan een gecontroleerde uitrol van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

 Kennis delen binnen het team.


 Change- en releasemanagement
 
 De bestaande change- en releaseprocessen zorgvuldig toepassen.

 Ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding, uitvoering en opvolging van releases.

 Kwaliteit, risico's en stabiliteit bewaken tijdens wijzigingen in productieomgevingen.


 📝 Jouw profiel
 
 Je hebt ruime ervaring met de ontwikkeling van .NET-gebaseerde toepassingen en backendontwikkeling in C# en .NET Core.

 Je hebt een goede kennis van Angular 2 of hoger en ervaring met frontendtechnologieën zoals JavaScript, HTML en CSS.

 Je hebt ervaring met Azure-ontwikkeling, waaronder API Management, App Service en Service Fabric.

 Je bent vertrouwd met webservices zoals WCF, SOAP, Web API en REST.

 Je hebt kennis van relationele databanken, bijvoorbeeld Oracle en SQL.

 Je past unit testing toe in je dagelijkse ontwikkelwerk.

 Je hebt ervaring met Agile ontwikkelingsmethodieken.

 Je werkt vlot met Atlassian Jira en Confluence.

 Je bent vertrouwd met procesgestuurde organisaties en met een ITIL-gebaseerde proceswerking.

 Je beschikt over sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden.

 Je kan complexe vraagstukken omzetten in concrete oplossingen en verwerft snel inzicht in bestaande toepassingen en processen.

 Je werkt zelfstandig, gestructureerd en nauwkeurig, met aandacht voor kwaliteit, performantie en onderhoudbaarheid.

 Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid op, communiceert helder en draagt actief bij aan de samenwerking in het team.

 Je bent leergierig en bouwt graag nieuwe technologieën en domeinkennis verder uit.


 💼 Aanbod
 Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).
