jobs.title: Staff Field Engineer, Federal
jobs.description:
About IonQ : 

 IonQ , Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 


 Job title : Field Engineer, Federal
 Location : College Park, hybrid or remote
 Travel : Up to 20%
 Role:
 IonQ is building the world's best quantum security solutions, and our Federal customers face some of the most complex security problems there are. As a Field Engineer, Federal, you will join the Field Engineering team, which sits where customers, markets, products and quantum security applications meet. This is the team where quantum security ideas become applied work with real mission impact.
 You will work alongside scientists, engineers, sales, marketing, business development and product management to grow IonQ 's quantum security business across Federal civilian, defense and intelligence agencies. We are looking for a versatile engineer who enjoys technical sales, demonstrations and working directly with customers, and who wants to bring IonQ 's quantum security products to the Federal market.
 Responsibilities:
 You will be the technical voice of IonQ in Federal customer conversations. You will explain our strategy and quantum security portfolio, answer detailed technical questions, and help agencies see how quantum security, post quantum cryptography and quantum key distribution apply to their missions. You will turn customer needs into technical proposals and proofs of concept, working closely with the IonQ Application Engineering team.
 You will also feed what you learn back into the business. Insights from Federal customers will shape our products through Product Management and Engineering. Working with sales, marketing, developer relations and business development, you will build a pipeline, handle competitive objections and grow IonQ 's presence in the Federal security community.
 Key responsibilities include:
 
 Leading Federal customer discussions, workshops and technical demonstrations that show how quantum security applications can support their mission

 Mapping customer requirements to quantum security approaches, including post quantum cryptography implementations, and delivering proofs of concept with Application Engineering

 Turning customer needs into technical proposals, and creating sales assets that explain IonQ 's quantum security and wider quantum products

 Working with the sales team to develop and progress a pipeline of Federal opportunities, including competitive objection handling

 Representing IonQ at industry and government conferences and events, and bringing customer insight back to Product Management and Engineering


 You’d be a good fit with: 
 
 4+ years of field engineering experience, helping customers solve complex problems through technology

 6+ years of experience working with Federal civilian, defense or intelligence agencies, or Federal systems integrators

 Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or another STEM field such as Chemistry, Physics, or Engineering

 Background in cyber security, ideally in network and cloud security


 You’d be a great fit with: 
 
 A security clearance

 A master's degree or PhD in a STEM field adjacent to quantum computing, security or cryptography

 Experience in technical sales or another customer-facing technical role, including leading technical events and speaking in public

 Broad architecture skills across a range of technologies


 OTE for this role is expected to be $250K
 
 Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

 At IonQ , we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

 US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law. 

 US Non-Technical Jobs. Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

 If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer - InfiniBand / UFM
jobs.description:
Who We Are 


 Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

 Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

 We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

 The Way We Work

 The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

 
 
 Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

 
 Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.

 
 Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.

 
 Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.

 
 Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.

 
 Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.




 What We Are Looking For 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer (InfiniBand / UFM) to design, deploy, automate, and operate next-generation AI Factory networking infrastructure supporting large-scale GPU clusters. This role is responsible for building and maintaining high-performance NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand fabrics that power AI training and inference environments utilizing NVIDIA UFM, NCCL, RoCEv2, and modern data center technologies.
 The ideal candidate has deep expertise in InfiniBand networking, NVIDIA Unified Fabric Manager (UFM), large-scale GPU deployments, Linux networking, automation, and troubleshooting distributed AI workloads. The network is the foundation of distributed AI training. Performance bottlenecks at the fabric layer directly impact customer workloads. This role will shape how Lightning scales from tens of thousands of GPUs to significantly beyond — ensuring deterministic performance, predictable scaling, and enterprise-grade reliability. If you want to architect infrastructure that powers frontier AI research, this is the role for you.
 This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time. 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Design, deploy, and maintain large-scale NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics supporting AI/ML GPU clusters.

 Deploy and administer NVIDIA Unified Fabric Manager (UFM) Enterprise for monitoring, provisioning, telemetry, and fabric health.

 Configure and optimize NVIDIA Quantum and Quantum-2 InfiniBand switches.

 Troubleshoot fabric performance issues impacting NCCL, MPI, GPUDirect RDMA, and AI training jobs.

 Implement and validate fat-tree, Dragonfly+, Clos, and spine-leaf network architectures.

 Perform firmware lifecycle management for InfiniBand switches, adapters (HCAs), and UFM infrastructure.

 Optimize congestion control, adaptive routing, QoS, and traffic engineering for high-performance GPU communication.

 Work closely with AI platform, GPU infrastructure, storage, and systems engineering teams to deploy scalable AI Factory environments.

 Automate network provisioning using Python, Ansible, Git, REST APIs, and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies.

 Monitor network health using UFM telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and other observability platforms.

 Support high availability, maintenance windows, incident response, root cause analysis, and capacity planning.

 Participate in architecture reviews and define networking standards for AI infrastructure.


 What You'll Need
 Required Qualifications 
 
 7+ years of experience in large-scale data center networking.

 Experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting InfiniBand environments.

 Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, and spine-leaf architectures.

 Strong Linux administration experience.

 Experience with network automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools.

 Experience with network troubleshooting, observability, and telemetry tooling.

 Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.


 Ideal Experience 
 
 Experience with Netris, Terraform, or similar infrastructure tooling.

 Experience with multi-region backbone design.

 Exposure to bare-metal provisioning systems.

 Experience operating HPC, GPU-dense, or other large-scale infrastructure environments.

 Experience working in high-growth infrastructure startups


 Compensation 
 
 We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.


 The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:

 $170,000—$210,000 USD



 
 Benefits and Perks 

 We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

 
 
 Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

 
 Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.

 
 Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).

 
 Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.

 
 Company-Wide Winter Break: Two weeks of company closure each winter to disconnect and recharge.

 
 Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.

 
 Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.

 
 Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.

 
 Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.

 
 Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.

 
 In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.



 Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

 At Lightning AI , we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
 If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you! 
 ⚡ What we’re doing
 We are on a mission to eliminate bottlenecks and revolutionize the food and beverage CPG supply chain by developing innovative, all-in-one software that starts with the contract manufacturer.
 Contract manufacturers and contract packagers (collectively, co-packers) are facilities that have extra production capacity and provide their services for a fee to customers (brands). Co-packers play a vital role in the trillion dollar U.S. Food and Beverage (F&B) Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry, providing a range of services to convert raw materials into finished goods. These facilities are responsible for blending, drying, baking, frying, forming, and milling raw materials into bottles, pouches, cans, and other packages for our favorite foods and drinks. They are vital businesses for all food and beverage brands, including the thousands of emerging food and beverage brands that lack the resources to handle manufacturing on their own. 
 We’re building vertical B2B SaaS for F&B manufacturers to run all aspects of their daily operations from estimating costs and ordering raw materials to tracking inventory, managing communication with food and beverage brands, and automating production tasks. Our platform consolidates fragmented software systems and streamline workflows both internally within their business, and externally as they collaborate with their brand customers.
 👬 Who we are
 Our founding team is no stranger to the complexities of the F&B industry. Our CEO Crawford launched coffee-focused beverage brands and began advising numerous CPG brands and manufacturers. He has lived and breathed the supply chain and manufacturing problems in the food and beverage industry as both an entrepreneur and investor. Our CTO Soheil has 6+ years of experience as a senior software engineer and tech lead at Amazon AWS and Google, across the full stack of software development and scaling and leading engineering teams. And, we're not alone.
 We've raised $1M from Bienville Capital and have a team of advisors ranging from industry veterans and consultants.
 We believe that our team is our greatest competitive advantage and take pride in having a team of exceptional humans. As a team, we value integrity, customer obsession, bias for action, lean product development, ownership and accountability. If this sounds like you and you're excited by the idea of getting in at the ground level to be part of building the infrastructure that will power the future of the food and beverage industry, we would love to hear from you!
 ✅ Who you are
 We are building out our early engineering team with well-rounded, resourceful, full-stack engineers who want to create a product literally from the ground up. You are someone who loves building products that delights users. An ideal candidate for this role is not afraid to work on any part of the stack from infrastructure to front-end and is excited about the breadth of responsibility and autonomy. You are someone who people can depend on to get things done and take responsibility for your commitments. You love working alongside smart and talented people who are action oriented.
 🌟 You’ll be responsible for 

 As a founding engineer, you will be working closely with our CTO and CEO to understand the product strategy and lead software development using lean and agile methodologies. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development process, architectural decisions, recruiting and building the organization in general. This is a unique opportunity for someone who likes to both dive deep on the technical side and zoom out to collaborate with the executive team on setting a strategic future.
 You will work across the full stack, designing and implementing modular systems with the right balance of structure and flexibility, building solutions that enable positive user experiences and meet the business needs of our pilot and future customers.
 Requirements
 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering

 5+ years of experience in architecting, developing, testing, and launching web apps end to end

 Experience working across the stack (front-end, back-end, DB, DevOps, etc.)

 Fast learner who is comfortable dealing with ambiguity and hard problems

 Experience with software development best practices (Scrum, testing, lean development, SOLID principles, code reviews)


 Bonus Points
 
 Previous experience at a high-growth fast-paced startup

 Entrepreneurial mindset (we encourage all employees to be future founders and this can be a great stepping stone towards that goal)

 Experience with our tech stack: NextJS, React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, Mantine UI, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Trpc API


 Compensation + Benefits
 
 Competitive cash compensation

 Equity ownership at a fast-growing company

 Remote work optional

 Tremendous growth opportunity and autonomy

 Health benefits included


 Our Culture
 
 Customer obsession

 Bias for Action

 Ownership and accountability

 Openness and honesty

 Integrity


 Equal Opportunity Employer
 At Bottleneck Labs, we believe that the only way we can tackle the challenging problems in front of us is by having diverse perspectives and an environment that promotes inclusivity. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
 About Zero21 

 As recruiters helping to build the next generation of industry disruptors, we are committed to expanding the startup ecosystem so that exceptional talent from diverse communities can gain greater access to more early stage companies. 
 We work only with equal opportunity employers who welcome candidates from underrepresented, underestimated, and traditionally overlooked communities to further diversity, equity, and inclusion in the next cohort of industry-disrupting unicorns.

 We are seeking a skilled Backend Engineer to join our dynamic and passionate team at Anlatan . The ideal candidate should have a strong background in computer science, with in-depth knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and software design principles. 
 You will be working on building new backend services, also you will be maintaining, updating and enhancing our existing code for our SAAS products, NovelAI and AetherRoom.
 Responsibilities
 
 Writing and designing well performant, secure and scalable backend services.

 Develop and maintain software applications using Go programming language and GRPC framework.

 Deploy and manage applications on Kubernetes.

 Design, develop, and optimize SQL databases.

 Troubleshoot and resolve database-related issues.

 Utilize Git for version control and collaboration.

 Work and communicate with the rest of the Anlatan team to efficiently build and ship new updates and products.

 Participate in the architecture design of new services and the implementation of them.

 Work closely with the frontend team at the integration of the backend and the frontend.

 Troubleshoot and debug issues in the production environment.


 Requirements
 
 Proficiency in Go programming language and GRPC framework.

 Experience with writing and using RESTful APIs.

 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and the k8s ecosystem, like Helm.

 Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

 Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

 Experience in working with large and ever-changing codebases.

 Past experience with designing high performance scalable backend services.

 Understanding of good security practices.


 Bonus Points
 
 Knowledge of NoSQL databases like Cassandra, ScyllaDB, MongoDB, etc.

 Experience with TypeScript and NodeJS for maintaining and working with our legacy NovelAI codebase.

 Experience with payment system APIs, like Stripe and Paddle.

 Knowledge of common software design patterns

 Familiarity with CI workflows like Github Actions, CircleCI, etc.

 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Google Cloud.


 Why work for us?
 We're working fast to send ripples through the ever-moving field of AI, we offer a competitive salary package, and of course, we're all pretty fun to work with.
 We offer a competitive salary and benefits, including:
 - A casual and flexible work environment
 - A culture focused on pushing the envelope and having fun while doing it
 - Incredibly flexible PTO
 For US Citizens
 - Health Insurance
 - Vision and Dental Insurance
 - Life Insurance and Disability
 - 401k (3% Match 100%, 2% Match 50%)
 For non-US Citizens
 - Health Insurance
 - Vision and Dental Insurance
 Beyond all else, our members are encouraged to:
 1. Explore and Experiment
 Unless we’re completely focused on getting a specific feature done, feel free to try something new out! Every idea brought to the table is appreciated and discussed.
 2. Work Stress-free
 We’re here to push boundaries in the AI consumer world, but that doesn’t mean you can’t have a little fun along the way. Our entire team emerged from the internet, so we’re a long ways from professional.
 3. Ask For Help
 No one is all-knowing. Sometimes all you need a little poke in the right direction to get something done. Never be afraid to reach out if it means getting your problem solved sooner rather than later.
 4. Interact with the Community
 Our community is what keeps us going, and we try to recognize that every single day. A primary goal of ours is to stay connected, and we pursue that by keeping in touch with our users through multiple different mediums.

jobs.title: Developer Advocate
jobs.description:
About Canvas Medical : Canvas Medical is on a mission to reimagine healthcare technology. Our platform provides a modern, developer-friendly electronic medical records (EMR) system, enabling better patient care and empowering healthcare innovators. By combining cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of clinical workflows, we’re transforming how healthcare is delivered.
 
 Role Overview: As a Developer Advocate at Canvas Medical , you will be the voice of the developer community and a bridge between external developers and our internal product teams. Your primary goal will be to champion the needs of developers integrating with Canvas Medical ’s API, provide technical guidance, and ensure our developer tools and documentation empower users to build impactful healthcare applications. This role is ideal for a technical communicator passionate about healthcare innovation and developer enablement.
 Key Responsibilities
 
 
 Community Engagement: Build and nurture relationships with the developer community through forums, social media, webinars, and meetups. Act as the primary point of contact for external developers, collecting feedback and sharing insights with internal teams.

 
 Technical Advocacy: Create and maintain high-quality documentation, tutorials, sample code, and SDKs to support developers using Canvas Medical ’s API. Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to enhance API usability based on developer feedback.

 
 Content Creation: Write blog posts, produce videos, and deliver presentations showcasing best practices, new features, and real-world applications of Canvas Medical ’s API. Develop technical content for hackathons, developer conferences, and community events.

 
 Support and Enablement: Provide direct support to developers, helping them troubleshoot issues and optimize their integrations. Conduct workshops, office hours, and training sessions to onboard developers to the Canvas Medical platform.

 
 Evangelism: Represent Canvas Medical at conferences, trade shows, and other industry events as a technical expert and advocate. Share the vision of Canvas Medical and its impact on healthcare innovation.


 Qualifications
 
 
 Technical Expertise: Proficient in programming languages like Python, JavaScript, or similar, with experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs. Familiarity with FHIR standards is a plus.

 
 Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for a broad audience.

 
 Healthcare Knowledge: Understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, EMR systems, and developer challenges in health tech is highly desirable.

 
 Developer Focused: Proven track record of engaging with developer communities or contributing to open-source projects.

 
 Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous improvement.


 
 Canvas Medical provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 Research shows that women and other minority groups might avoid applying if they don't meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet everything listed in the job posting.

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.
  • Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.
  • Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.
  • Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.
  • Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.
  • Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use
  • Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation
  • Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling
  • A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team
  • Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling
  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents
  • Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python
  • Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer
  • Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption
  • Technical project management experience

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 
 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams 
 Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model.
 The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software.
 
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track.
 You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns.
 You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level.
 
 🧩 What you’ll be working on: 
 Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches.
 Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration.
 Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes.
 Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over
 New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases.
 Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability.
 Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands.
 
 🙌 You should apply if: 
 You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management.
 You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field.
 You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers.
 You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability.
 You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer.
 You care about operational reliability and release quality.
 Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable.
 
 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
 
 More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
 How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office.
 🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

 Competency Interviews : leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total

 Deep-dive interviews : domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total

 Final interview : values alignment (30-45 mins)


 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
  
 What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Lab Automation
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 
 We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
 We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
 Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
 We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
 About the Role
 You'll build work-cell orchestration, instrument drivers, protocol scheduling, error-recovery logic, and monitoring. Physical systems fail in ways pure software doesn't — a plate gets stuck, a liquid handler skips a well, a temperature controller drifts. Your job is to make the system handle all of it gracefully. This is a broad, hands-on role for a strong engineer who wants their code to drive real machines and see it run the same day.
 What You'll Do
 Build orchestration software that coordinates liquid handlers, plate readers, incubators, and robot arms — handling timing dependencies, state, and error recovery.

 Reverse-engineer and develop instrument drivers and APIs. Each instrument speaks a different protocol (serial, USB, TCP/IP); you work out how it talks and build a clean abstraction over it.

 Model and execute complex multi-step protocols reliably — a single run can span dozens of steps across multiple instruments.

 Build error-recovery logic so that when something fails mid-run, the system retries, skips, alerts, or pauses depending on the failure mode.

 Create monitoring and observability for work-cell health: instrument status, run progress, error rates.

 Debug across the software–hardware boundary — figuring out whether bad data is a comms, firmware, calibration, or code problem.

 Work closely with lab automation engineers, the rest of the software team, and the scientists running production.


 Stack
 TypeScript and Python, Postgres (Supabase), Modal for compute. We control instruments with open-source Python tooling like PyLabRobot and PyHamilton wherever we can, rather than proprietary vendor GUIs.
 What We're Looking For
 Strong software engineering skills. You write production code in Python and/or TypeScript — well-structured and maintainable, not just prototypes.

 Comfortable at the hardware-software boundary. You've built software that drives physical devices, or you're excited to. You can read a protocol spec, debug a flaky connection, and reason about timing.

 Lab automation experience is a strong plus. Familiarity with PyHamilton, PyLabRobot, Opentrons, or similar tooling helps — as does a background in robotics, industrial automation, IoT, or embedded systems.

 Maker and hacker attitude. You like figuring out how closed systems work and building the thing that makes them work better. Bonus if you're comfortable with electronics, microcontrollers, or a 3D printer when an integration needs a physical fix.

 AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce.

 Self-starter and independent. You define what needs building from how the lab actually works, not just what's in the ticket.

 Reliability-minded. The lab runs 24/7; you design systems where one instrument failing doesn't cascade through the whole work cell.


 Biology background not required — but you should be excited that the code runs real experiments.
 Details
 Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site — you need hands-on access to physical instruments).

 Type: Full time

 Start date: ASAP


 
 Application deadline 
 We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows  
 myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   
 We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   
 We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   
 With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  
 Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 
 The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer 
 As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.
 Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.
 
 What you'll do in this role
 Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

 Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

 Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

 Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

 Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

 Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

 Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.


 
 What you bring to the table
 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

 Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

 Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

 Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

 Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

 Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

 Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

 Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

 Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

 Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

 Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.


 
 What success in the first 6 months looks like
 You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

 You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

 You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

 You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

 You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

 You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.


 Current tech stack
 We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.
 Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress
 Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j
 Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate
 Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.
 
 What we offer: 
 Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

 International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 


 Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 


 Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.  


 Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 


 Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 


 Hybrid working model. 


 Policies to support working parents. 


 Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.  


 Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp  


 Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 



 Equal opportunities 
 myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.description:
About the role 
 Help build the networks connecting SkyNRG’s offices and future production sites!
 As we scale Sustainable Aviation Fuel production, secure and reliable connectivity between our IT and operational environments becomes increasingly critical. We are looking for a Network Engineer (IT/OT) to design, build, and operate the network architecture supporting our Amsterdam headquarters, first production facility, and future sites.
 This is a hands-on role with real influence over how our network landscape develops, from routing, switching and Wi-Fi to firewalls, IT/OT segmentation, and secure remote access.
 Reporting to the IT Operations & Infrastructure Manager, the role works closely with IT, security, plant engineering, and automation partners.
 
 Your Responsibilities: 
 Design, build, and operate IT and OT network infrastructure at headquarters and production sites, from Purdue Level 3 upward and at the boundary with plant control systems

 Manage and optimize our Fortinet (IT) and Palo Alto (OT) firewall environments, including rule sets, segmentation, and the industrial DMZ

 Operate Cisco Catalyst switching and Meraki wireless at our production sites, alongside the office network at headquarters

 Implement and maintain secure remote access for employees and vendors, including zero trust access

 Deploy and operate Nozomi Networks for OT asset visibility and threat detection, and integrate network and OT logs into our SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel)

 Support incident response together with our security team and managed SOC provider, and contribute to NIS2 compliance activities
 


 This is an opportunity to build an IT/OT network from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy landscape. You will work with a modern technology stack, have real influence over architecture decisions, and see the direct impact of your work on our operational reliability and cybersecurity maturity.
 The position is based at our headquarters in Amsterdam. Expect regular travel to the production site during construction and commissioning, becoming occasional once the site is in operation.
 
 Your profile 
 As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.
 You recognize yourself in the following: 
 5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, including hands-on responsibility for enterprise firewall environments

 Strong experience with Fortinet FortiGate or Palo Alto Networks firewalls, and the willingness to master the other

 Solid knowledge of routing, switching (preferably Cisco Catalyst), wireless, VPN technologies, and network security best practices

 Experience with, or strong knowledge of, OT and industrial network environments, including ICS and SCADA systems

 Understanding of IT/OT segmentation principles and frameworks such as IEC 62443 and the Purdue Model, including industrial DMZ design

 Experience with OT monitoring solutions, preferably Nozomi Networks or comparable platforms such as Claroty or Dragos

 Comfortable working in both office and plant environments, including regular travel to production sites

 Professional proficiency in English


 
 Nice-to-haves: 
 Certifications such as Fortinet FCP (NSE 4+), Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, Cisco CCNP, Nozomi Networks, IEC 62443, or GICSP

 Experience within the process industry, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, or another industrial environment

 Familiarity with NIS2 and experience translating regulatory requirements into practical technical controls

 Experience with zero trust network access (such as Zscaler) and Microsoft Azure networking

 Experience integrating network and OT logs into a SIEM, preferably Microsoft Sentinel

 Automation or scripting experience with Python or Ansible, and Git-based workflows

 Experience working with EPC contractors or automation vendors during plant construction and commissioning

 Dutch language skills


 
 About SkyNRG 
 Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.
 Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.
 Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.
 Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.
 
 At SkyNRG, you’ll find:
 An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

 Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

 A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

 A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF
 


 What we offer 
 We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.
 Besides that, we offer:
 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

Across these interconnected programs, your team will enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, lead communities, and turn their experiences into compelling content and conference talks for Datadog and third-party channels. This role combines people leadership, program strategy, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence to amplify authentic customer voices, deepen understanding of Datadog and its products, and foster a thriving community of practitioners.

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Lead and develop a team of Developer Advocates, setting clear expectations, guiding priorities, coaching performance, supporting career growth, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture
  • Own the strategy, goals, and roadmap for Community Advocacy, translating broader Advocacy and company priorities into focused programs and measurable outcomes
  • Guide the continued development of our Ambassador, Champion, and User Group programs, creating clear contributor journeys, expectations, enablement, recognition, and opportunities for customer engineers to increase their impact
  • Build repeatable systems that enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, create content, share best practices, and serve as trusted leaders within their communities
  • Develop a strong pipeline of customer stories by identifying compelling practitioners and helping them shape authentic, technically credible narratives
  • Oversee the support, co-development, and coaching of conference talks by customer engineers—from identifying an idea and developing an abstract through content review, rehearsal, and delivery—for Datadog events, including our flagship user conference, DASH, as well as third-party industry conferences
  • Establish measures of success for Community Advocacy, using qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate program health, contributor engagement, content quality, audience impact, and customer outcomes
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, Customer Success, and regional teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and scale customer participation across Datadog initiatives
  • Ensure insights from Ambassadors, Champions, User Group participants, speakers, and other community members are shared with the appropriate teams inside Datadog, strengthening the connection between our customers and our products
  • Balance strategic leadership with selective hands-on contribution, including coaching speakers, reviewing technical content, participating in community programs, and representing Datadog when appropriate

 

Who You Are: 

  • You are an experienced people manager who has led autonomous technical professionals, coached performance, developed talent, and translated complex goals into achievable plans
  • You have experience defining and delivering successful developer advocacy, developer relations, technical community, or a related functions
  • You have built or meaningfully contributed to programs that enable external practitioners to participate, contribute, create content, or lead communities at scale
  • You have experience helping technical practitioners develop and communicate their stories, including coaching conference speakers or co-developing technically credible talks and content
  • You are a former software developer, SRE, or other technical practitioner—or have equivalent technical depth—with the judgment needed to assess technical accuracy and coach effective technical narratives
  • You are a thoughtful cross-functional leader who can build alignment, make prioritization decisions, and influence partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, and customer-facing organizations
  • You use both data and community insight to evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities, and make decisions about where the team should invest
  • You understand how to build trust with technical communities and value authentic practitioner voices over purely promotional messaging
  • You are comfortable operating through ambiguity, establishing structure where needed, and evolving programs as Datadog’s products, customers, and technical audiences grow

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

  • You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.
  • Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.
  • You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.
  • You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.
  • You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.
  • You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.
  • You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.
  • You have a very good command of English, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.
  • You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.
  • You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

  • An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.
  • The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.
  • An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!
  • A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.
  • A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.
  • Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!
  • A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.
  • A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.
  • The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

Type: Full-time or project-based (contractor)
Language: Spanish (fluent) and English (technical)

About us

We are a new mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) in Mexico that competes on value, not price. We are building two products on a single platform:

A B2B platform where companies onboard, manage their mobile lines and cost centers, and receive electronic invoices (CFDI) allocated by cost center.
A perks layer for consumers: every mobile line includes discounts and benefits delivered through WhatsApp and the web, powered by AI agents.

The role

Design integrations with external providers (telecom carrier APIs, perks catalogs, e-invoicing) using adapters, retries and fallback plans.
Build security in from day one: minimal personal data, secrets management, least privilege, encryption, audit logs and privacy compliance.
Review and approve code, document architecture decisions and communicate risks to leadership in business terms.

What we are looking for

7+ years in software development, including 3+ as an architect or technical lead.
Preferably available for 6-month/1-year service
You have designed and shipped a SaaS or B2B platform to production, end to end.
Proven experience leading engineers: code reviews, architecture decisions and mentoring.
Strong Python (FastAPI or Django) and PostgreSQL.
Event-driven systems: queues, retries, idempotency and failure recovery.
Production experience with Google Cloud or AWS.
Hands-on generative AI: LLM integration, RAG, tool calling or agents, including cost and quality control.
Application security: authentication, role-based access control and data protection.

Nice to have

Multi-agent architectures or MCP servers.
WhatsApp Business API.
Telecom, fintech, payments or loyalty and benefits programs.
Mexican e-invoicing (CFDI) or payment integrations.
Next.js or React.
Security frameworks such as NIST or ISO 27001.

What we offer

Remote work with planned visits to Mexico City.
The chance to architect two products from scratch, with direct business impact.
A mobile line with our premium plan and perks.

jobs.title: Experienced Full-Stack Developer Required – Integrated Enterprise Management System
jobs.description:
Experienced Full-Stack Developer Required – Integrated Enterprise Management System

I am looking for an experienced freelance developer or small development team to design and develop a professional web-based **enterprise management system** covering learning, training, nonconformance management, continuous improvement and change management.

The modules should work together through common user accounts, permissions, approval workflows, document storage and reporting. The platform must support multiple organizations with separate data and work smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile browsers.

The scope includes:

- Learning and training management:** Course administration, registration, scheduling, attendance, assessments, certificates, training records, expiry reminders and competency tracking.
- Nonconformance report (NCR) management:** Create and categorize NCRs, assign responsible persons, record investigations and root causes, track corrective actions and deadlines, attach evidence, verify effectiveness and approve closure.
- Continuous improvement:** Capture improvement opportunities and suggestions, evaluate and prioritize proposals, assign actions, track implementation and record outcomes.
- Change management tracker:** Register proposed changes, document reasons, assess impacts and risks, obtain approvals, assign implementation actions and track completion and review.
- Administration and reporting:** Organization and user management, configurable forms and workflows, dashboards, notifications, document storage, audit trails and report exports.

The following expectations are essential:

- Complete development: Handle requirements clarification, UI/UX design, frontend, backend, database, testing and deployment. Deliver a fully functioning application ready for operational use.
- Agreed scope and milestones: Confirm requirements, dependencies, deliverables, timelines and acceptance criteria before development. Propose a practical phased delivery plan.
- Design approval: Provide wireframes or a clickable prototype for approval before full development.
- Integrated, maintainable architecture: Use consistent navigation and shared records across modules, with clear links between related NCRs, improvement actions and changes. The system must support future expansion.
- Security and traceability: Implement secure authentication, role-based permissions, separation of organizational data, protected documents, audit history and backup/recovery arrangements.
- Progress visibility: Provide regular updates, working demonstrations at each milestone and ongoing access to the source-code repository.
- Testing and corrections: Test individual modules and complete workflows across modules. Provide a staging environment for acceptance testing and resolve critical and major defects before final acceptance.
- Complete handover: Supply source code, database structure, deployment instructions, administrator documentation and all necessary account access.
- Post-launch support: Include a defined bug-fix warranty period and specify maintenance arrangements.
- Transparent pricing: Identify inclusions, exclusions, third-party services and recurring costs. Additional work must be agreed before it is charged.

Payments will be linked to completed and accepted milestones.

Please include relevant enterprise software projects you have personally delivered, your role in those projects, your recommended technology stack, estimated cost and timeline, team composition and assumptions. Provide a cost breakdown by module and identify the shared platform development costs.

I am looking for someone who understands business workflows, can recommend practical improvements and takes responsibility for delivering a reliable finished product.

 Build your career with Jabil! We challenge and empower you to make most of your talents, working with outstanding colleagues from diverse backgrounds who share your drive and passion to make Jabil grow!  Jabil Monument’s diverse capabilities help our customers succeed in the complex, evolving healthcare marketplace.  Constructed in 1979 the location employs approximately 1,000 employees and contractors manufacturing orthopedic nails and screws along with neurological products for joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports medicine and other uses.
  
 JOB SUMMARY :
 The Engineering Technician II provides hands-on technical support for precision manufacturing equipment and processes, with a primary focus on Star Swiss lathes equipped with FANUC controls and FANUC robotic automation. Team members receive guidance, training, and support while building the confidence to troubleshoot issues and take greater ownership of their work. Growth is shaped by individual initiative and supported by experienced colleagues who collaborate, share knowledge, and help remove barriers. We value talented individuals who ask questions, bring forward practical ideas, and identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, and manufacturing performance while following established documentation and procedural requirements.
  
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Provides hands-on technical support for Star Swiss lathes, FANUC controllers, FANUC robots, and related manufacturing equipment.

 Performs machine setup support, adjustments, recovery activities, basic repairs, and verification testing in accordance with approved procedures and training.
 Reads and works with CNC G-code and demonstrates awareness of FANUC Macro B programming, including variables, logic, and macro calls used in established programs.
 Executes assigned technical tasks independently after objectives, priorities, and applicable procedures are defined; seeks clarification when requirements are unclear.

 Reviews completed projects for accuracy, clarity and completeness.

 Supports all company safety and quality programs and initiatives.
 May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  
 Job Qualifications and Knowledge Requirements: 
 High School Diploma, Associate degree, technical certificate, apprenticeship, or equivalent combination of relevant education and hands-on experience preferred.
 Typically requires two or more years of relevant technical experience in CNC machining, equipment support, automation, maintenance, or a related manufacturing environment.
 Experience supporting Swiss-style CNC lathes is strongly preferred; experience with Star machines and FANUC controls is highly desirable.
 Experience with FANUC robots or comparable industrial robotic automation is preferred.
 Working knowledge of CNC G-code and awareness of FANUC Macro B programming concepts are preferred.
 Demonstrates strong mechanical aptitude, systematic troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and sound technical judgment within the scope of the role.
 Demonstrates initiative, ownership, and the ability to plan and complete assigned work with limited supervision.
 Demonstrates patience and discipline when completing documentation, investigations, approvals, and other required manufacturing processes.
 Experience in medical device or another regulated manufacturing industry is preferred; aerospace manufacturing experience is also beneficial.
 Communicates effectively, works constructively across functions and shifts, and asks appropriate questions when technical or procedural requirements are unclear.

  
 Other Requirements: 
 Participates in and understands compliance related activities pertaining to the job assignment including compliance with the Quality System Regulation (QSR), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), and applicable Work Instructions.
 Follows all laws and policies as they apply to one's job and maintains the highest levels of professionalism, ethics and compliance at all times.
